title: Personal Credit Cards: Automatic Payment for a Balance Remaining at Closing
content:
A Personal Credit Cards account can be closed while money is still owed on it. This page covers the automatic payment instruction that is left in place when a card is closed with a balance outstanding.

## What the rule sets

Where a card is being closed with money still owed on it, the automatic payment left behind for collecting that money is an instruction of the `fixed_amount` kind, drawn on a PCB checking account that belongs to the cardholder and is active. The fixed sum it collects is worked out under the card's closing terms.

## Recording the instruction

An automatic payment instruction is always the cardholder's own. The agent unlocks the tool `set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9` and gives it to the customer themselves to run. A run replaces whatever instruction the card carried with the kind, fixed monthly sum and paying checking account supplied; nothing else on the card is altered, and the cardholder sees the new instruction on the card at once.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the credit card account receiving the instruction, from the card account lookup | identifier |
| `autopay_option` | which automatic payment is taken on each due date | `none` (nothing taken), `minimum_due` (the statement's minimum payment), `statement_balance` (the full statement balance), `fixed_amount` (the sum in `autopay_amount`, never more than the statement balance) |
| `autopay_amount` | the fixed monthly sum when the kind is `fixed_amount`; 0.00 for every other kind | USD, two decimals rounded half-up |
| `autopay_source_account_id` | the cardholder's PCB checking account that pays the card, from the checking account lookup | identifier; left empty only when the kind is `none` |

## Receipt

The tool answers with `status` "set", `card_account_id`, `autopay_option`, `autopay_amount`, `autopay_source_account_id` and `recorded_at`, the timestamp of the change. The instruction is in force once that answer is returned.
